source: I want a game 3d game that we can run around in unlock new areas rebirth to get more powerfull and we can unlock pets armor fight bosses i want gems that you get from rebirthing that you can use for upgrades I want 15 different areas to unlock through the game currency lunar that each have a different cost for example 1st zone 1x second 1.5x something like that I want different pets for each area that go up in value but also increase your clicks per second and I want the game to be called clicker phyco

answers.ask: What should the world look like - the name and the lunar currency hint at space, but you never said. Space, fantasy, or something else?
answers.answer: Use a space-themed world to match the Lunar currency, with each area being a different planet or lunar zone.

answers.ask: Are the fifteen areas one continuous world you run between, or separate places you teleport to?
answers.answer: Make the fifteen areas part of one continuous world that players run through and unlock in order.

## Clarifications resolved
- [author] theme — Q: What should the world look like - the name and the lunar currency hint at space, but you never said. Space, fantasy, or something else? A: Use a space-themed world to match the Lunar currency, with each area being a different planet or lunar zone.
- [author] scale — Q: Are the fifteen areas one continuous world you run between, or separate places you teleport to? A: Make the fifteen areas part of one continuous world that players run through and unlock in order.
- [agent_inferred] progression layout — Q: How are the fifteen areas ordered physically? A: Arrange them as one continuous readable sequence, with a visible purchase gate before each new planetary or lunar zone.

## Enriched image prompt
Create a continuous space-themed clicker world made of exactly 15 distinct planetary or lunar zones that players run through and unlock in order. Lay the areas out as a readable progression route, with each zone visibly different from the next and a physical unlock gate marking every threshold. Begin with a shared upgrade hub for pets and armor, then connect all 15 zones without teleports or separate maps. Give the zones open clicking and travel ground plus defined boss encounter spaces, and place a clearly marked rebirth destination after the final tier.

## Genre
The genre is Simulation. The rising click power, increasingly valuable pets, area-cost multipliers, upgrades, currency, gems, and rebirth loop identify a stat grinder rather than an obby or racing game.

## Shape and preset
Use `tier-ladder`: the 15 areas form a line or broad spiral of increasingly valuable training zones separated by progression thresholds. Match the Stat Grinder preset, omitting a dedicated training station because the author describes clicking as the activity but does not request a specific physical training prop.

## Config requirements
Use `social-hub` for the starting pet, armor, and upgrade storefront area; `gate-progression` for the visible barriers before successive planetary zones; `path-circulation` for the continuous run between all 15 areas; and `hazard-aggro`, taken from RPG, for boss encounter grounds kept clear of the main route. The zone visuals differ across all 15 while remaining within one coherent space-world register.

## Layout requirements
Place one `trigger-rebirth` pad beyond the fifteenth and final zone. Place `spawner-npc`, taken from RPG, at each authored boss ground without inventing a boss count the source did not provide. Currency values, click multipliers, pet bonuses, upgrade costs, and rebirth rewards remain mechanics rather than map placements.

## Layout components
The build contains one starting upgrade hub, exactly 15 sequential planet- or moon-themed zones, a continuous path through all of them, visible progression gates at their thresholds, boss grounds set off the main circulation, and one terminal rebirth area. Keep every zone reachable on foot in strict order and compose the sequence so the tier progression reads clearly in one frame.

## Render order
Use `topdown`: the authoritative concern is the uninterrupted ordered connection through all 15 gated areas; the space-themed isometric dressing follows that plan.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is large because 15 individually legible zones, shops, gates, and boss grounds must fit within one continuous traversable world. The theme is a colorful space world with distinct planetary and lunar areas. `P0` applies: the tier ladder stays on one connected surface with no separate maps, enterable interiors, overhangs, or validity route forced by the requested geometry.
